What is the estimated income of a movie with a budget of $500M?

In [19]: Copied! 
model = LinearRegression()
X = pd.DataFrame(new_movies, columns=["production_budget_usd"])
Y = pd.DataFrame(new_movies, columns=["worldwide_gross_usd"])
model.fit(X, Y)
theta0 = model.intercept_[0]
theta1 = model.coef_[0,0]
price = theta0 + theta1 * 500_000_000
print(f"The estimated income of a movie with a budget of $500M is ${round(price):,}")
